description: Audit 2026-11-03 (napoleon-remastered docs/audits/AUDIT_2026-11-03.md) R1. ctl.py:155-156 applies min(d, 360-d) only when d <= 360, so asking for yaw 270 and reading back -90.00001 reports failed with a 0.0002 px fit (napoleon run 20261103_j24pc raw/f2_stock/y_270_cam.json; J8 and J24 both explained it away). Use abs((g - e + 180) % 360 - 180) wherever ctl compares angles, with host tests at 270 vs -90.00001, 0 vs 359.9999 and 180 vs -180. Then a jobs check rule: every result with status failed in a run folder a report cites is named in the report's deviations.
title: Yaw wrap in ctl readback, and failed ctl results named in the report
